info.title: Name and description
info.name: Base name
info.descriptionHint: Shown under the base name on its page.

delete.title: Delete base
delete.description: Deletes {{name}} with its tables, views, dashboards and automations for everyone. You can undo it right after.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: What people and groups can see and do in {{base}}. Each one holds a single role here.
roles.note: A role does nothing until it is given to people or groups.
roles.toMembers: Give roles on the Members page
roles.caption: Roles of the base

system_admin.name: Admin
system_admin.description: Full access: data, tables, views, automations, roles and sharing. Cannot be changed or deleted.

system_editor.name: Editor
system_editor.description: Adds and edits records. Can be narrowed, never widened beyond editing data.

system_reader.name: Reader
system_reader.description: Reads records only: never adds, edits or deletes.

roles.name: Name
roles.nameTaken: A role of this base already has this name.

create.title: New role
create.description: It starts with no access to any table: give it permissions, then give it to people or groups.

delete.label: Delete {{name}}
delete.title: Delete the role “{{name}}”?
delete.description: Nobody holds it. Deleting cannot be undone.

inUse.title: “{{name}}” is still assigned
inUse.description: Give these people and groups another role, or remove their access, before deleting it:

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: People and groups of the organization, and their role in {{base}}.

rules.title: How access is decided
rules.direct: A role given to a person directly wins over the roles of their groups.
rules.groups: Someone in several groups with roles here gets everything any of these roles allows.
rules.full: Organization owners and admins, workspace admins and the base owner always have full access. That is not changed here.

members.caption: People and groups with their role
members.empty: The organization has no members or groups yet.
members.removed: {{name}} no longer has a role in this base.

remove.title: Remove the access of {{name}}?
remove.user: {{name}} can no longer open {{base}}, unless one of their groups has a role here.
remove.group: Members of {{name}} lose the access this group gives to {{base}}, unless they hold a role of their own or through another group.

editor.title: Role
editor.missing: This role does not exist any more.

ceiling.system_admin: The Admin role has full access and cannot be changed. Give a narrower role to people who should not manage the base.
ceiling.system_editor: Built-in Editor role: it can be narrowed, never widened beyond editing data. “Manage” is off: editors never change tables, fields or views of a table.
ceiling.system_reader: Built-in Reader role: it reads only. “Manage”, “Edit”, adding and deleting records, and editing fields are off.

adjusted.title_one: The server adjusted {{count, number}} permission when saving
adjusted.title_other: The server adjusted {{count, number}} permissions when saving

editor.savedAdjusted_one: Permissions of “{{name}}” saved, {{count, number}} adjusted: see why next to it.
editor.savedAdjusted_other: Permissions of “{{name}}” saved, {{count, number}} adjusted: see why next to each.

unsaved.label: Unsaved changes
unsaved.blocked_one: {{count, number}} table needs a fix before saving.
unsaved.blocked_other: {{count, number}} tables need a fix before saving.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.description: The changes to this role are not saved. They are lost if you leave.

reasons.computed_field_max_read: {{field}} was lowered to {{to}}: computed fields are at most Read.
reasons.filter_field_min_read: {{field}} was raised to {{to}} because a record condition uses it.
reasons.filter_field_min_create: {{field}} was raised to {{to}} because a record condition uses it and the role can add records (new records must still match).
reasons.operations_require_edit: {{table}}: adding and deleting records were removed ({{from}}): they need Edit or Manage.
reasons.reader_ceiling: {{table}} was lowered to {{to}}: the Reader role only reads.
reasons.editor_ceiling: {{table}} was lowered to {{to}}: the Editor role never goes above Edit.

blocked.admin_read_only: The Admin role cannot be changed.
blocked.editor_ceiling: Not for the Editor role: it never goes above Edit.
blocked.reader_ceiling: Not for the Reader role: it only reads.
blocked.table_read_only: The table is Read only: give it Edit or Manage first.
blocked.table_no_access: The role has no access to this table.

issues.filter_invalid: A record condition is not valid.
issues.filter_incomplete: A record condition misses a value: complete it or remove it.
issues.read_filter_missing: “Records matching conditions” needs at least one condition.

baseRule.title: General permissions
baseRule.description: What the role may do with the data it reads, in every table.

copy.label: Copy
copy.hint: Copy cells and records to the clipboard. Off: copying from the grid is blocked.

download.label: Download and export
download.hint: Export to CSV/XLSX, print, duplicate the base, download files.

share_link.label: Create share links
share_link.hint: Share views and forms by link. Anyone with the link sees what this role reads.

matrix.title: Tables
matrix.hint: A table left at “No access” is hidden from the role: its name never shows and links to it show only a lock.
matrix.hintSystem: Tables created later get this role's default level.
matrix.caption: Access of the role to each table
matrix.empty: The base has no table yet.
matrix.detailsOf: Details of {{name}}: views, records and fields
matrix.fieldsAdjusted_one: {{count, number}} field adjusted when saving: see Details.
matrix.fieldsAdjusted_other: {{count, number}} fields adjusted when saving: see Details.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.hint: A dashboard left at “No access” is hidden from the role. New dashboards start at “No access” for this role: give access here.
dashboards.hintSystem: Built-in role: it views every dashboard of the base, including new ones. This cannot be changed here.
dashboards.hintAdmin: The Admin role views and edits every dashboard of the base.
dashboards.caption: Access of the role to each dashboard
dashboards.empty: The base has no dashboard yet.
dashboards.widgets: Widgets still apply this role's table, field and record permissions: a widget over data the role cannot read shows “No permission”.

detail.noAccess: The role has no access to this table. Choose a level above to set views, records and fields.

views.title: Views
views.description: Which shared views the role sees, and whether it may change them. Personal views are always the person's own.
views.allowEditHint: Create, rename, reorder and delete the table's shared views.
views.onlyHint: Other views are hidden and cannot be queried, also through the API.

records.title: Records
records.description: Which records the role edits and reads. Conditions can use the current user, their groups and linked records.
records.editEmpty: No condition yet: every record can be edited.

read.editable: Only the records it can edit

records.linkWarning: A condition uses “has none of” or “is empty” on a link field. Only linked records that are not in the trash count: moving a linked record to the trash or deleting it changes which records this role reads or edits.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: What the role may do with each field of the records it reads.
fields.modeHint: Choose “Choose per field” to change fields one by one.
fields.caption: Field permissions in {{name}}
fields.computed: Computed: at most Read (Edit and Create only are saved as Read).
fields.inFilter: Used in a record condition: at least Read when saved.
fields.inFilterCreate: Used in a record condition: at least Create only when saved (the role adds records).
fields.optionsHint: Fields where the role may add new options while typing. Off for everyone but admins by default.
fields.downloadsHint: Only files of the checked fields can be downloaded; the others can still be viewed.
fields.downloadsAll: Files of every readable field can be downloaded. Choose per field to limit it.

summary.noAccess: The role does not see this table.
summary.readEditable: Reads only the records it can edit.
summary.readEditableAll: Reads the records it can edit (every record, without a condition).
summary.addOnly: Can add records, not delete them.
summary.deleteOnly: Can delete records, not add them.

access.title: Access of {{name}}
access.description: What this person can open and do in the base, as the server resolves it now.
access.notPreview: Read-only summary, not a preview of the whole app: it shows the result of their roles, not the screens they see.

source.org_admin: Organization owner or admin: full access to every base.
source.base_owner: Owner of the base: full access.
source.workspace_admin: Admin of the base's workspace: full access.
source.direct_role: The role {{roles}}, given to them directly (it wins over group roles).
source.none: No access: no role in this base, directly or through a group.

access.allTables: Full access: every table, record and field, and the schema.

scopes.editable: Only the records they can edit

access.notCounted: Not counted (only the first 20 tables are)
